import re,glob
TAG=re.compile(r'''<app-pill(?=[\s/>])((?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^>"'])*?)(/?)>(\s*</app-pill>)?''',re.S)
ATTR=re.compile(r'''\s*([\[\(]?[\w.-]+[\]\)]?)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')''')
M={'info':'neutral','success':'positive','warning':'caution'}
def neg(e):
    e=e.strip()
    if e=='true': return 'false'
    if e=='false': return 'true'
    m=re.fullmatch(r'!\((.*)\)',e,re.S)
    if m and balanced(m.group(1)): return m.group(1)
    if re.fullmatch(r'!(?![=(])[\w.?\[\]\'"()]*',e) and not e.startswith('!!'): return e[1:]
    if re.fullmatch(r"[\w.?\[\]'\"]+(\(\))?",e): return '!'+e
    return '!('+e+')'
def balanced(s):
    d=0
    for ch in s:
        d+=ch=='('; d-=ch==')'
        if d<0: return False
    return d==0
need=set()
def conv(m,f):
    body=m.group(1); out=[];label=None;pipe=False
    for a in ATTR.finditer(body):
        n=a.group(1); v=a.group(2) if a.group(2) is not None else a.group(3)
        q='"'
        if n=='label': label=v
        elif n=='[label]': label='{{ %s }}'%v
        elif n=='[disableTooltip]': out.append('[tooltip]="%s"'%neg(v))
        elif n=='variant': out.append('tone="%s"'%M[v])
        elif n=='[variant]':
            if "'" in v:
                out.append('[tone]="%s"'%re.sub(r"'(info|success|warning)'",lambda k:"'"+M[k.group(1)]+"'",v))
            else:
                out.append('[tone]="%s | pillTone"'%v); pipe=True
        else: out.append(a.group(0).strip())
    assert label is not None and ''.join(a.group(0) for a in ATTR.finditer(body)).replace(' ','').replace('\n','')==re.sub(r'\s','',body), body
    if pipe: need.add(f)
    multi='\n' in body
    if multi:
        ind=re.search(r'\n([ ]*)',body).group(1)
        head='<app-pill'+''.join('\n'+ind+x for x in out)+'>'
    else: head='<app-pill '+' '.join(out)+'>'
    return head+label+'</app-pill>'
for f in glob.glob('src/app/features/**/*',recursive=True):
    if not f.endswith(('.ts','.html')): continue
    t=open(f).read()
    if '<app-pill' not in t: continue
    g=lambda m:conv(m,f)
    t2=TAG.sub(g,t)
    open(f,'w').write(t2)
for f in need:
    ts=f[:-5]+'.ts' if f.endswith('.html') else f
    t=open(ts).read()
    t=t.replace('imports: [ PillComponent,','imports: [ PillComponent, PillTonePipe,',1)
    t=t.replace('import { PillComponent,','import { PillTonePipe } from "../../lib/pill-tone.pipe";\nimport { PillComponent,',1)
    open(ts,'w').write(t)
print(len(need))
E
